exclusions._comment: Reconciles the netted metrics back to raw. Excluded records are NOT dropped -- they stay in conversations[]/new_leads[] carrying the flag that excluded them.

reporting.leads_by_tag_note: Counts are across all 238 currently-open opportunities in the two project pipelines (not lifetime). A handful of contacts carry more than one lead: tag simultaneously, so tag counts can sum to slightly more than 238 minus untagged.
reporting.avg_days_in_stage_note: Cold and Postponed averages are heavily skewed by a ~99-contact bulk-import batch frozen since pipeline launch (~2025-10-29) and the Bushrra/Luigi 535.6-day Postponed records -- see workflow_drift stale_approaching/abandonment_next.
reporting.opportunity_status_counts_note: Across all three pipelines combined, lifetime totals (not a daily metric). Consistent with the documented ~297 won / ~1,132 abandoned scale; abandoned has grown to 1,180 since 2026-07-31 (was 1,144).
reporting.store_pipeline_note: STORE: Material Pipeline has 48 open / 6 won / 7 lost / 2 abandoned (63 total) -- unchanged from 2026-07-31. Retail material sales, distinct from project work. No stale thresholds are defined for this pipeline (it runs its own +3d/+8d automated cadence) so no staleness prediction is made here.

stale_thresholds_used._comment: Echoed from platform-settings/ghl-workflow.json so the output is self-describing and a threshold change is visible in the diff.

meeting_window_summary._comment: The window any new Meeting-scheduled follow-up sequence must fit inside. Threshold counts from stage entry, so appointments booked far out shrink the usable runway.

reporting.followup_not_fired_check_note: Scoped this run to today's 33 active conversations rather than a full-account sweep of every mobile-quote-tagged contact. All mobile-quote leads active today (Rafay, Harj Heer, Ushi Masrani, Oz Aziz, Jayanthan Kuhananthan, Clerance Pitters) had their 3-day check-in fired within the 5-day window. A full sweep of Warm/Cold for overdue quote follow-ups outside today's activity was not performed this run given volume -- same scope limitation as 2026-07-31, still recommended as a follow-up analysis.
